title: The Admiral's Last Order

texts.details:
Here is my part. We took that keep from him once. The Warchief and Rexxar of the Mok'nathal broke his camp on this coast, and he fell back over the water to Theramore, his daughter's city.

Jaina Proudmoore had begged him to stop. When he would not, she showed the Warchief where ships could be had, and asked only that her own people be spared. Rexxar killed the Admiral in his citadel. Thrall kept his word and left Theramore in peace.

So who holds the keep now? Not his army. These came after: his reserve, under his second, Lieutenant Benedict. Their quartermaster, Tidewell, counts stores on the shore below the walls. A quartermaster writes everything down. Bring me what he carries.
texts.objectives: Kill Quartermaster Tidewell on the shore below Tiragarde Keep and bring the Musty Letter he carries to Magga in Razor Hill.
texts.progress: He will have it on him. Men like that trust paper more than they trust the sea.
texts.completion:
Give it here. My eyes are slow with their letters.

"Stores for forty days. The Lieutenant says we hold to the Admiral's orders, written before he sailed: finish what was begun. Lieutenant Alverold's ships are expected. No sail yet."

Written before he ever left Kul Tiras, $N. The Admiral is dead, his daughter has made peace, and these men are still obeying him. They are waiting for a fleet.

I thought I would be glad to know it.

idea: Chain 2 of 3: how the Admiral was beaten and killed at Theramore, what Jaina did, and that the men in the keep now are his reserve under Lieutenant Benedict, following orders written before he sailed and waiting for Alverold's fleet.
